Sarah 

Appreciate the checklist  received and reviewed. Attaching our SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and a draft BAA for your legal. A few quick answers to your points: 

- Dedicated capacity: Redwood Dedicated provides isolated GPU pools and can be provisioned so that only your tenant has access to those nodes; network egress and ingress controls can be limited per your policy. We can commit to per-region Dedicated pools (us-east) and provide SLAs on availability/latency in the SOW.
- Private VPC: for the highest assurance (and if your auditors require customer-managed networking and KMS/HSM), our Private deployment puts the control plane in your VPC and integrates with your KMS. This is our recommended path if you need on-prem-like control.
- Hosted API: fastest to get started, but for PHI and SOC2 + strict network isolation, Hosted is often not sufficient for customers that require a BAA + isolated tenancy.

I've attached: 
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_Report.pdf (stub, redacted)

Best,
Marissa
